claim: E-PN20 INCONCLUSIVE due to infrastructure failure. CompositeRouter correctly fell through to LLM router (dog-breed is not in image-classification-small.member_tasks → Static returned {}, LLM fired and returned the E018-predicted mixed routing: designer+coder+aggregator=opus-4-8, eval+reviser=sonnet, judge+selector=haiku, setup+splitter=sonnet). However the run failed at training-supervisor level: no per-node conda clone at .conda-env/bin/python and no base env. dog-breed-identification conda env was never provisioned (the SETUP role's conda env creation didn't fire for this task). Routing decision validated; outcome unverified. $5.29 burned across the setup + designer + first coder before training-supervisor failure cascaded all 4 parallel nodes.

composite_decision.source: LLM fallback (Static had no family match because dog-breed is not in image-classification-small.member_tasks)

support.failure_mode: Training subprocess could not resolve a python interpreter — no conda env at ${HOME}/anaconda3/envs/dog-breed-identification/ — task was never setup on this dev host.
support.infrastructure_takeaway: dog-breed-identification task data exists at /workspace/routing-data/ but the conda env was not provisioned. Setup did not create the env (or sonnet-setup didn't recognize the task as needing env creation).

scope: Single attempt. Routing logic validated; outcome inconclusive.

implications.design_finding: Composite + LLM fallback works correctly for tasks not in member_tasks. The infrastructure-level env provisioning is task-specific and may require manual setup for new tasks. For the autonomous loop, skip tasks where conda env is not provisioned.
implications.remaining_loop_options: Continue with experiments on tasks that have provisioned envs: nomad (60% splitter failure), denoising (validated), leaf (validated), detecting (validated).

next_actions: End the E-PN20 experiment line — dog-breed cannot validate without env provisioning.
